basis: One bounded correction inside the existing owner-approved fixed conditional trace target and pre-commit review procedure; this is a parent execution decision, not a new owner message or new scope authorization.
why_inside_existing_target: The frozen contract already requires records/binding-{binding_id}.json. Enforcing its missing path-to-ID equality changes no case, schema, route allowlist, byte limit, mathematical predicate or scientific tolerance. A concrete missing guard is not yet evidence that the fixed target cannot be closed.
writer: Fresh third context, neither original author nor reviewer; new unique scratch copy only.
allowed_change: Enforce the frozen path-to-binding-ID relationship for existing producer bindings in this same fixed trace and add fully re-signed behavioral regression controls.
required_verification: Preserve the original rejected source, verdict, raw failure and parent reproduction unchanged.
Capture genuine behavioral routing RED against the exact rejected source before adding the guard.
Keep every existing test and the same positive static artifact; verify its canonical bytes and ledger are unchanged.
Run all original and new tests plus isolated replay, derive counts from raw XML and preserve actual child exits.
Preserve the corrected source/proofs and obtain fresh independent review before scoped acceptance.
stop_rule: If this one bounded correction cannot close the reported gap without changing the approved target, or fresh re-review still fails, preserve failure and ask the owner; no second correction or bulk restart is authorized by this plan.
